page_title: UNI 1-0 DAR | Union Berlin v Darmstadt 28/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+6' Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Union Berlin) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Marcel Schuhen makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner.
90+5' Matthias Bader (Darmstadt) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
90+4' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
90+2' Here comes a substitution. Kevin Behrens is given a rest as he is replaced by Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Union Berlin).
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

89' A big rebound falls at the feet of Julian Justvan (Darmstadt). He doesn't hesitate and unleashes a shot towards goal, but it fails to get through a wall of players and ricochets away off one of his own teammates.
89' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
87' Here is a change. Robin Gosens is going off and Danijel Jumic gives the last tactical orders to Rani Khedira (Union Berlin).
87' Substitution. Fabian Nurnberger is replaced by Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt).
87' A substitution has been made. Fabian Holland is replaced by Matej Maglica (Darmstadt).

84' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom right corner. However, Marcel Schuhen anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
83' Substitution. Brenden Aaronson has come on for Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin).
83' Today's match ends for Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) who will be replaced by Janik Haberer.
83' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
83' The referee is firm and issues Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) a deserved yellow card.
81' Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
80' Gerrit Holtmann (Darmstadt) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Frederik Ronnow scrambling, but it flies just wide of the left post.
79' Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) is first to the cross from Luca Pfeiffer, but fires his header just past the left post from close range.
78' Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar.
77' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
76' Andras Schafer finds the head of Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) with a clever free kick, and he crashes in a powerful close-range header at goal that just flies past the left post. Unlucky!
75' Christoph Zimmermann (Darmstadt) commits a nasty foul by bringing down his opponent.
72' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) replacing Bartol Franjic.
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gerrit Holtmann (Darmstadt) is coming onto the pitch as Tim Skarke cannot continue after picking up an injury.
72' Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) decides to try his luck with a first-time bullet of a shot. Unfortunately for him, he doesn't hit the ball perfectly and his effort ends well wide of the left post.
70' The game is interrupted now, Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
68' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the left side of the goal, but Marcel Schuhen was alert and made an amazing save!

65' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
65' Harm Osmers blows his whistle for a foul after Christoph Zimmermann (Darmstadt) hacks down one of his opponents. There is a free kick near the sideline to Union Berlin.

62' 1 - 0 Andras Schafer feeds the ball through to Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:0!
59' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) receives the ball in space inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends his first-time shot well wide of the left post.
58' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt will have a goal kick.
55' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
52' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) finds a little space near the penalty spot and heads the corner from Christopher Trimmel goalwards, but the attempt goes miles wide of the right post.
51' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
49' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Darmstadt comes to nothing.
48' Union Berlin can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
48' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) unleashes a decent strike heading to the bottom right corner, but the keeper dives like Superman and keeps it out.
48' Some trickery by Alex Kral allows him to set up Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) on the edge of the box , and he blasts the ball at goal but it misses the right post by a whisker.
46' The whistle blows and Harm Osmers starts the second half.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' A rebound on the edge of the box falls to the feet of the unmarked Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin). He doesn't hesitate and shoots towards goal, but unfortunately for him it hits one of his own teammates.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
43' Union Berlin players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
39' Tim Skarke swings the cross over. Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) gets his head to it but it goes just wide of the right post.
38' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
37' Wow, what an escape. Bartol Franjic (Darmstadt) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
36' Alex Kral (Union Berlin) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies miles wide of the right post.

35' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the left post.
34' Christopher Trimmel bends the corner in towards the goal and finds Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) almost on the goal line, but he somehow contrives to head the ball high over the bar.
34' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
33' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
32' Alex Kral (Union Berlin) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
31' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 3:3. The number of shots on goal at present is 0:0.
28' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) sends a cross into the box, but Marcel Schuhen comes off his line to gather the ball.
26' Tim Skarke slips the ball to Matthias Bader (Darmstadt), who hastily shoots from distance and sends the ball well wide of the left post.

25' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header, but it goes well wide of the left post.
24' Harm Osmers blows his whistle after Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Union Berlin will take a free kick.
24' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Frederik Ronnow, who smothers the ball.
21' The ball is cleared after Alex Kral (Union Berlin) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
18' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
18' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
14' Clemens Riedel (Darmstadt) is being substituted because of an injury. Torsten Lieberknecht sends Christoph Zimmermann on the pitch.
14' Clemens Riedel (Darmstadt) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
12' Clemens Riedel (Darmstadt) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
12' One of the players from Union Berlin times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
12' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
11' Union Berlin are ruled offside.
5' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) is in the right place at the right time to receive a rebound and decides to shoot from long range, but his effort is immediately blocked.
5' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
5' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates. Now Darmstadt have a corner.
2' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marcel Schuhen intercepts the ball.
1' The first half has started.
Darmstadt will kick-off.
Harm Osmers is introduced as the referee for today's match.
